hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.status // "draft") == "published") then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "ask", permissionDecisionReason: "Feriaeitalia guide status is published - requires manual approval"}} else {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "allow", permissionDecisionReason: "Draft-only Feriaeitalia guide edit auto-approved"}} end'

jq -c '(.tool_input.status // "draft") as $status | ((.tool_input.destination // "") | ascii_downcase) as $dest | ((.tool_input.breadcrumb.region // "") | ascii_downcase) as $region | if $status == "published" then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "ask", permissionDecisionReason: "Beach status is published - requires manual approval"}} elif ($dest | test("elba|tuscany")) or ($region | test("elba|tuscany")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "allow", permissionDecisionReason: "Draft Tuscany/Elba beach create auto-approved"}} else {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "ask", permissionDecisionReason: "Destination not pre-approved for auto-create - requires manual approval"}} end'
